name: static-column-rotation
lua_assertions:
local spline = create_spline():set_dimension(3):set_loop(true):set_size(1):set_point(1, {0, 0, math.pi})
for _, time in ipairs({-0.5, 0, 0.5, 2, 4, 200}) do
 local rotation = spline:evaluate(time)
 assert(rotation[1] == 0 and rotation[2] == 0 and math.abs(rotation[3] - math.pi) < 1e-6, 'unsolved single-knot rotation')
end
spline:destroy()
